senses.gloss: अदंष्ट्र m. A snake whose fangs are taken out.
अदक्षिण a. (f. णा) 1. Unfavourable; 2. unskilled; 3. left (as a hand); 4. without any gifts (as a sacrifice).
अदक्षिण a. (f. णा) 1. Unfavourable; 2. unskilled; 3. left (as a hand); 4. without any gifts (as a sacrifice).
अदत् a. Toothless.
अदत्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Not given; 2. given unjustly; 3. not given in marriage.
अदत्त (II) n. A donation which is null and void.
अदत्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Not given; 2. given unjustly; 3. not given in marriage.
अदत्ता f. An unmarried girl.
अदत्त-आदायिन् m. one who seizes what has not been given away, a thief (in law).
अदत्त-पूर्वा f. not betrothed before, भगवत्यदत्तपूर्वेत्याशङ्क्येत M.M.iv.
अदन n. Eating.
आदान n. 1. Taking, receiving, कुशांकुरादानपरिक्षतांगुली K.S.v.11; 2. acceptance; 3. earning, getting, आदानं हि विसर्गाय सतां वारिमुचामिव R.iv.86.
अदन्त (I) a. (f. न्ता) 1. Toothless; 2. ending in अत्.
अदन्त (II) m. A leech.
अदन्त (I) a. (f. न्ता) 1. Toothless; 2. ending in अत्.
अदान्त a. (f. न्ता) 1. Untamed; 2. unsubdued.
अदान्त a. (f. न्ता) 1. Untamed; 2. unsubdued.
अदभ्र a. (f. भ्रा) Not scanty, plentiful.
अदभ्र a. (f. भ्रा) Not scanty, plentiful.
अदर्शन n. 1. Disappearance, elision, लोपोऽदर्शनम् Pan.; 2. absence of sight.
आदर्शन n. 1. Showing; 2. a mirror.

अदस् Pron. (m. असौ, f. असौ, n. अदः) That (referring to a thing that is not near); अदसस्तु विप्रकृष्टं … रूपम्. अदस् is also used in the sense of तत् and as the correlative of यत्; but in this case it must not immediately follow the relative; when it immediately follows the relative, it only expresses ‘प्रसिद्धि’ (For further information on the point, See K.Pr.vii. under विधेयाविमर्श).

अदस् Pron. (m. असौ, f. असौ, n. अदः) That (referring to a thing that is not near); अदसस्तु विप्रकृष्टं … रूपम्. अदस् is also used in the sense of तत् and as the correlative of यत्; but in this case it must not immediately follow the relative; when it immediately follows the relative, it only expresses ‘प्रसिद्धि’ (For further information on the point, See K.Pr.vii. under विधेयाविमर्श).
अदायिक a. (f. की) 1. Unclaimed on account of want of persons entitled to inherit, e.g. अदायिकं राजगामि; 2. not relating to inheritance.
अदायिक a. (f. की) 1. Unclaimed on account of want of persons entitled to inherit, e.g. अदायिकं राजगामि; 2. not relating to inheritance.
आदंश m. 1. A bite; 2. a tooth.

आदर m. 1. Respect, regard, reverence, अमर्षशुन्येन जनस्य जन्तुना न जातहार्देन न विद्विशादरः Kir.i.33, भूयान् दारार्थमादरः K.S.vi.13, 20; 2. commencement; 3. care, close application, K.S.vi.91; 4. love; 5. effort, अपौरादरानिर्मिता K.S.vi.41.
आदरण n. Respect, notice.
आदर्श m. 1. A looking-glass, a mirror, आत्मानमालोक्य च शोभमानमादर्शबिम्बे K.S.v.22, R.xvii.27; (used metaphorically also, e.g. आदर्शो गुणानाम् Kad.); 2. copy of a work; 3. a commentary, gloss.
आदर्शक m. A mirror.
आदहन n. 1. Burning; 2. injuring, killing; 3. a cemetery.
